title: Simplify legal pages and service providers list
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Simplified the public legal pages. The Service Providers page now uses one list explaining what each provider does, draws model providers from the registry, and includes Google Workspace for support email. A gen test checks that the provider list stays in sync with the registry, and the model-management skill notes the requirement. The Terms shorten service-level, warranty, liability, and termination wording, state consumer rights on service changes, and remove the confidentiality section; former sections 12–16 become 11–15. The Privacy Policy shortens wording on sub-processors, transfers, email, cookies, and security. The Refunds page corrects EU withdrawal wording for digital services and removes the subscriptions section and review-time target.

Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with warm cream, mint and lavender around the prominent lime green.
